steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Brrr... Helena, ain't it way too cold in here today?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Almost out of charcoal. Have to save some for later.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Just burn that mountain of bills piling up at my place. The bank's just gonna send more anyhow.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: *cough*

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Did you catch a cold? C'mon, let's swing around to my place and grab a stack of that waste paper.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: (*whispers*) Why do you think I'm coughing? Not in front of her...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Oh, if it ain't Sylvia!

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: G-Good morning, Mr. Theremin...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What brings someone from the bank out here to our shabby little establishment? Something wrong?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: S-Sorry...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Leone, I ain't seen Benny in a while. What's the kid been up to?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Busy with his studies. Got his nose in a book till dawn every night.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Didn't the school close down a while ago?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Our neighbor, Ms. Selena, used to be a schoolteacher. She reckoned it'd be a real shame for Benny to miss out on all that book learning, so she's been letting him study at her place.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Huh, good for him. Benny's always been a smart kid, and he was real shook when he learned he wouldn't be able to go to school no more.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Yeah. He was so anxious that whole year.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: M-Mr. Theremin, actually, I... I could teach Benny too...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Oh right, you graduated from the best business school in Columbia—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: And what's he supposed to learn from you? How to become a banker so he can bury people in bills too when he grows up?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Leone, eat your damn breakfast before it freezes over!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: I-I need to get to work, so I'll be leaving now... I'll leave the money on the table.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You know she ain't responsible for any of the loans here in Davistown, right? What're you giving her lip for?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Then let her have a heart-to-heart with the others. They'll be even harsher, I guarantee it.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: But still, we watched her grow up...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: That's exactly why! Pisses me off even more!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, ma'am. I hope we're not too late.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Oh... H-Hello. It's fine, you're not late at all.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What would you like me to call you?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: You can call me, uh...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Achoo—!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: How long have you been standing here, ma'am?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Since... this morning. The message only said you'd be arriving today, but not the specific time.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But it's already afternoon. You've been standing here this whole time?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Three hours ago we sent a notification to the plate, updating them on our ETA.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...I-I didn't get anything of the sort.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's weird. Who sent you?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Um... the manager.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Manager? That's not a title I'm used to hearing in government work.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Actually, I... I'm not from the government. I work for a local bank.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Since when is a bank in charge of this?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Actually... Um, actually, Davistown is...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: We're here, Captain Liskarm. Is this woman the one in charge of our reception?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Wait, Sylvia? They sent you out here for this?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Th-That's right, sir.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey, old man, any idea why the government sent a banker to pick us up instead?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: *sigh*... You'd best ask the bank directly. I sure ain't gonna be able to explain all the twists and turns.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Alright then. Franka, go ahead and take the gentleman home. And while you're at it, take a walk around Davistown to get a better grasp of the situation here.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Laura, bring the others with you and find a good place for a safe house where we can securely stow our supplies and vehicles. If you manage to get a hold of Jessica, report it to me right away.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sylvia and I will head to the bank... to find out what exactly is going on here.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's our teacher's pet for you. Thanks for volunteering for the hard part.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Where should we regroup once we're all finished?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Y'all can meet up at the only diner still open in town. It's right by the only road to the mine. Run by a real nice lady named Helena.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: And if this Jessica of yours finds her way into town, I reckon that's where she'll end up too.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Mm... It's decided, then.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: The bank is right up ahead, Miss...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: People have been avoiding us the whole way here... Had I known, I'd have asked Franka to take my equipment back with her first.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: N-No, that's not why...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Oof...

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: You asshole, you run into someone and don't even apologize?

steps.name: Pale Man
steps.text: It's over...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sir? Are you okay?

steps.name: Pale Man
steps.text: ...It's all over.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sir? Sir! What happened?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: What's going on... He looks like his soul has left his body. Where's he going?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Do you recognize him, Sylvia?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: No, I... umm...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Let's, um... h-head to the bank first.

steps.name: Advertising Board
steps.text: ...Along with the rapid development of pioneer settlements, nomadic plates both large and small have also been springing up.

steps.name: Advertising Board
steps.text: But at the time, very few financial institutions in Columbia were specialized in pioneering.

steps.name: Advertising Board
steps.text: ...After looking deeply into the living conditions of the countless pioneers on the frontier's edge, our founder decided to plant his roots alongside them and established the first bank to provide practical financial support to the lower and middle classes.

steps.name: Advertising Board
steps.text: He prided himself in building trust, showing kindness, and doing his best to provide attentive service to everyone who walked through his doors in the rough-and-tumble frontier.

steps.name: Advertising Board
steps.text: It wasn't long before his hard work and empathy won him wide recognition.

steps.name: Advertising Board
steps.text: Then, we began forming close and fruitful partnerships with local governments, working together with mining and pioneering companies to help them flourish and expand rapidly into settlements just like Davistown.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Quite the legend, wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And who might you be...?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Sorry for keeping you waiting, Miss Liskarm. I am this bank's manager. My sincerest apologies for not being able to welcome you in person earlier.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We are aware of the problems facing Davistown. A few inconveniences are to be expected. However...

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: No need to be reserved. Feel free speak your mind.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We were planning to liaison with the local government, not a bank. What exactly happened to the government here?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Sylvia, did you not explain the situation?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Manager, I...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sylvia stood alone in the cold for the better part of the day. If you ask me, what she needs right now is hot water and a blanket.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Of course. Sylvia, take half a day off to go home and get some rest.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Okay... I'll see you later then, Miss.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Oh, Sylv—

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Miss Liskarm, if there's anything else you need, please let me know. Resources are scarce on this plate, but we will do everything in our power to accommodate you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but please don't try to change the subject.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Why is it that Blacksteel's client was the local government, but we're being greeted by your bank's employees? Where are the heads of the local government agencies?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Please come with me.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Are you telling me that your government officials are in the bank's garage?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: During last year's bankruptcy liquidation, the local government cut most of their departments and laid off most of their employees. But that wasn't enough to pay off the massive debts they still held. In the end, the remaining government buildings were put up for auction as well.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What about the mayor, then? Where is he?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Unfortunately, after the last mayor ran off with hardly a penny to his name, the townsfolk never found a suitable candidate to replace him.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: As you can see, all that remains today is... the mayor's secretary, and a few temporary employees.

steps.name: Mayor's Secretary
steps.text: Ha... Haha, it's okay. If the bank hadn't generously provided us with free office space, we'd be out on the streets.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: It's just the right thing to do. Besides, it's nothing compared to what you've been through.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Seeing as the government is still functioning, can we—

steps.name: Mayor's Secretary
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Mayor's Secretary
steps.text: I mean, as much as we'd like to help you, we simply don't have the manpower to support your work.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...Then, who's in charge of matters concerning our job here?

steps.name: Mayor's Secretary
steps.text: We've given full authority over that to the woman standing next to you. Go to her for anything you might need.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Absolutely. My door is always open.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...I certainly hope you can issue a formal document showing this authorization.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Mr. Secretary, when can she expect that document?

steps.name: Mayor's Secretary
steps.text: I'll have it ready right away! The official seal somehow went missing yesterday, so I've sent someone to go look for it!

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Now then... I'm very much looking forward to a mutually beneficial partnership.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: I'll show you to my office. Try not to dawdle, as we have many things to discuss before our work begins in earnest.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Mayor's Secretary
steps.text: Wait, just a moment, ma'am!

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: What is it now?

steps.name: Mayor's Secretary
steps.text: Um, well... It's been way too cold in here recently. W-Would you mind turning up the heat in the garage a smidge? Everyone's freezing down here.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: ...Of course. I'll always do my best to accommodate your needs.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Have you and your teammates decided on a rendezvous point?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um... N-Not yet. B-But, it'll be fine. I'll find somewhere to wait for them on my own...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Achoo!

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: There's a diner in Davistown. Wait in there.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wh-Where is it? Oh, um, you don't need to take me there. General directions should be fine...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Forget it, just come with me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh? Is he.... one of the plate's residents?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That man... Why doesn't he have anything with him?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Excuse me! Sir! Where are you going?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Hello? Are you leaving the plate? It's not safe out here!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Over here! I'm talking to you! Look, over here! Can you hear me?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir? Sir!
The man doesn't respond to Jessica's calls, and simply continues shuffling towards the snow in silence.
In front of him, the vast white stretches far into the distance, blending into the dark, ashen sky.
From Jessica's perspective, the vast snowfield gradually squeezes the man into a pale blue line. After a short while, he shrinks into a small dot, then finally disappears into the white.
Nothing remains to prove he was even there, save for the tracks he left behind.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Are you coming or not?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I'll be right there!

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: I'm back, Helena.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Woody? About time!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Wait... Where's Miles?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: He was rescued by this girl's friends.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Um, and who are you?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm, umm...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: ...She's a merc I met on the way. Her communicator broke, and she got separated from her teammates. So I brought her into town to wait for them.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Mind if I take a look at the communicator? Might be able to fix it up for you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: H-Here... Sorry to bother you like this.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No problem. You guys saved Miles, so what's a little communicator between friends?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: That said, why come here of all places?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...We received a commission from the local government to help Davistown restore its power facilities and get the plate back onto its navigation route.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hold on, girl, could you repeat that? Restore our power facilities? You ain't pulling my leg, are you?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You should see the goofy grin on your face.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Young lady, regardless of why you and your companions are here, thank you so much for rescuing Miles... I've been so worried I ain't slept a wink in days.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Alright... All's well that ends well? Then, got anything to eat?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Didn't have nothing ready, but looks like you brought something back for me.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Oh, right.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: A mother beast?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry... It was my fault...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: No use fretting over something like that, this time of year. Nothing beats meat.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Fair enough... Okay, you two, sit your butts down and grab something to drink. I'll prepare the meat—

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hey, why're you getting up to leave? Weren't you gonna eat?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Change of plans.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir... How badly damaged is the communicator?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Nothing serious. C'mon, let's go take a look around my warehouse. Might be some spare parts we can use—

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Stop tinkering for a second and give this a try.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Deep-fried? Now this is the good stuff!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: But... this definitely ain't enough for everyone.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: If you're worried about that, then stop scarfing it all down! The poor girl still ain't had a piece!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's totally fine. He helped me fix my communicator, so... he deserves to eat his fill.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: That barely counts for anything. It's so cold round these parts, we all gotta help each other out, just to get by. Give us a holler if you ever need anything.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Thank you. I appreciate it, ma'am.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: By the way, I happened to see someone a ways out from the plate. He wasn't carrying anything, and wouldn't respond when I called out to him... He just kept walking deeper and deeper into the snow, until I couldn't see him anymore...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Did something happen to him?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You're a guest here, young lady. Don't worry your pretty little head over stuff like that and just fill your tummy first, okay?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Then... would you mind if I asked you two about someone else?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: *sigh*... Kids these days. Barely stepped on the plate, and already so many questions. Alright, fine, ask away.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I wanted to know about a man named Woodrow Bianchi—

steps.name: Helena and Leone
steps.text: Who...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry, I guess you're not familiar with him. I'll try asking someone else.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No, that ain't the problem... You sure you're not confused?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Woodrow's the man who brought you here, though?
